title: New Methods Of Abduction

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL BRANCH
No. S. 10. 1. 1.
Date

News Digest of April 11, 1939, publishes the following
article written by one Hwa Loo-ken (華露根) :-

NEW METHODS OF ABDUCTION

I use to pass by a certain big clock on a certain
street every morning on my way to school. Yesterday morning
while I was passing near the big clock I was suddenly blind-
folded from behind. I at first thought that somebody was
playing a joke on me and I cried out, "Who is it? Don't
joke!"

Then I was relieved of my books and my hands were
fastened together at the back.

I was later placed in a truck. I began to worry
over my predicament for I am only a young girl. In the
truck there were several men and women. Cries and shouts
could be heard intermingled with the noise of slaps on the
face.

About 15 minutes later we arrived at a certain
place. One after another we were interrogated as if in a
Court. They were sent out one by one and they never returned.

Suddenly water was poured down from a high place
on my body and my legs began to feel limp. But I was
determined not to yield. I preferred death to dishonour.

I was pushed into a chair which had been connected
up with electricity and for the first time in my life I was
tortured with electricity.

Now began the inquiry by some Fukienese in mandarin:
"Where are you studying?"
"- - middle school."
(They already knew of this for my books bore the
name of the school.)

Q.- "What do you usually do in your school?"
A.- "We do all that students should do."
Q.- "What do you do? Give more details!"

1939年4月11日的《新闻摘要》刊登了华露根（Hwa Loo-ken）所写的以下文章：

绑架新手段

我每天早上在去学校的路上，都会经过某条街上的一个大钟。昨天早上，当我经过大钟附近时，突然有人从背后蒙住了我的眼睛。起初我以为是谁在跟我开玩笑，便喊道：“是谁？别开玩笑了！”

随后，我的书本被拿走，双手被反绑在背后。

后来我被塞进了一辆卡车。想到自己的处境，我开始担忧，因为我只是个年轻女孩。卡车里有几名男女。哭喊声与打耳光的啪啪声交织在一起。

大约15分钟后，我们到达了一个地方。我们像是在法庭上一样，一个接一个地接受审问。他们被逐个带出去，再也没有回来。

突然，有人从高处往我身上泼水，我的双腿开始发软。但我决心不屈服。我宁死也不受辱。

我被推到一把接通了电源的椅子上，平生第一次遭受电刑折磨。

接着，一些福建人用普通话开始审问：
“你在哪里读书？”
“——中学。”
（他们早已知道这一点，因为我的书上印有学校名称。）

问：“你平时在学校做什么？”
答：“我们做学生该做的一切。”
问：“你们做什么？说详细点！”
